summary: Phase 1A CMS end-to-end validation. Backend: 26/27 endpoint tests pass; 1 CRITICAL bug in upload-pdf (LLM cleanup) - emergentintegrations SDK does not expose the streaming API being used. Existing pytest suite test_contract_preview_toc.py 4/4 pass. Frontend: LegalDocEditor compile fix verified; all UI flows work (login, list, filters, editor, toolbar, TOC, page break, placeholder chips, autosave, save version, PDF preview, publish, version history with restore, auth guard, unauth redirect).

critical.issue: Returns 502 (Cloudflare) because backend crashes with ImportError. contract_pdf_pipeline.py line 210-212 does `from emergentintegrations.llm.chat import LlmChat, UserMessage, TextDelta, StreamDone` but the installed SDK only exposes `LlmChat` and `UserMessage`. Also calls `chat.stream_message(user)` which does not exist; only `send_message(user_message) -> str` is available. This breaks the entire PDF upload → LLM cleanup pipeline. Backend log excerpt: `ImportError: cannot import name 'TextDelta' from 'emergentintegrations.llm.chat'`. Fix: rewrite convert_to_html() to use `text = await chat.send_message(user)` and drop the streaming loop (or use file_contents for one-shot).

minor.issue: WeasyPrint logs `Failed to load image at 'file:///static/creative_mojo_logo.png': No such file or directory: '/static/creative_mojo_logo.png'` on every preview. PDF still generates but the running header shows a broken/empty logo. contract_branding.LOGO_STATIC_PATH resolves to an absolute path that WeasyPrint cannot read. Recommend either an absolute filesystem path or an https URL with base_url.

Second publish returns 200 (creates another 'Published (status → current)' version) rather than being a no-op / 409. This is not idempotent — each redundant publish click bloats version history. Spec allowed 200 or 409 so this passes tests, but recommend returning early without version-bumping when status already 'current'.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec says clicking 'UPLOAD PDF' should open a MODAL asking for name + contract type + file. Actual implementation uses native `window.prompt()` twice for name and contract_type (line 142-150). Poor UX and no validation of contract_type against the enum. User-facing 'contract_type' prompt expects raw token strings ('new_franchise', etc.) which is not user-friendly.

Tiptap console warning: `Duplicate extension names found: ['link', 'underline']`. Editor still functions but extension registration is duplicated (StarterKit already includes underline/link and they are re-imported/added separately).

integration_issues.issue: Because backend upload-pdf endpoint is broken (see critical), the Frontend upload flow cannot be validated. The frontend correctly POSTs multipart, but the response is 502 -> shown as an error toast. Once the backend LLM import bug is fixed, upload UI needs to be re-validated (navigation to editor, diff panel, grey imported-numbering chips).

action_items: P0 — Fix contract_pdf_pipeline.convert_to_html(): drop `TextDelta, StreamDone` and `chat.stream_message(...)`; use `text = await chat.send_message(UserMessage(text=_serialise_chunk(chunk)))` instead. This is the only blocker preventing HQ from uploading legacy PDF contracts.
P1 — Fix WeasyPrint logo path in contract_branding: use an absolute filesystem path or a public URL, so the running-header logo renders in the PDF preview.
P2 — Replace the two `window.prompt()` calls in AdminContractTemplatesPage.jsx (lines 142-151) with a proper modal for Upload PDF (name + contract_type dropdown + file input).
P2 — Make publish idempotent when status already 'current' (skip the version bump).
P3 — Remove duplicated tiptap extensions (link, underline) — StarterKit already includes them.
critical_code_review_comments: contract_pdf_pipeline.py — Streaming API used (`stream_message`, `TextDelta`, `StreamDone`) does not exist in the installed emergentintegrations SDK. This must have been added without live-testing the upload path; the existing pytest suite only covers WeasyPrint + numbering, so no test exercises this import.

contract_templates_routes.py — publish endpoint is not idempotent: repeated calls silently bump version history each time. The docstring/spec claims idempotent 409 or 200; behaviour is 200 + version each time. Consider early-return if status=='current'.
contract_branding — LOGO_STATIC_PATH format results in `file:///static/...` which WeasyPrint cannot resolve. Log spam on every preview.

AdminContractTemplatesPage.jsx — File upload UX regresses to `window.prompt()`; not accessible, not validating contract_type against the enum, could allow bad tokens through. Also would fail Playwright automation without dialog handlers.
LegalDocEditor.jsx — duplicate Tiptap extensions (link, underline) registered twice; console warning.

rca of the issue: P0 root cause: E1 (main agent) or an earlier iteration replaced a non-streaming Claude call with a hand-rolled streaming loop in contract_pdf_pipeline.convert_to_html() using symbols (TextDelta, StreamDone, chat.stream_message) that DO NOT EXIST in the emergentintegrations SDK version installed (`/root/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/emergentintegrations/llm/chat.py`). The SDK only defines: LlmChat, UserMessage, FileContent, ImageContent, FileContentWithMimeType, ChatError. LlmChat only exposes `send_message(user_message: UserMessage) -> str` and `send_message_multimodal_response(...)`. The upload path was never exercised end-to-end because the existing pytest coverage only tested WeasyPrint (contract_preview_toc.py) which imports contract_pdf_pipeline lazily and never triggers convert_to_html. Reproduction: POST a valid PDF to /api/admin/contract-templates/upload-pdf → backend logs show `ImportError: cannot import name 'TextDelta' from 'emergentintegrations.llm.chat'` → HTTP 502 (Cloudflare) after backend returns 500. Mitigation: rewrite the loop as `raw = await chat.send_message(UserMessage(text=_serialise_chunk(chunk)))` and drop the fragments/stream loop; keep the exception-fallback for chunks that fail.
